title: TriMas Packaging Lodi site achieves strong BRCGS, FDA and ISCC PLUS results
summary: TriMas Packaging's Lodi, Italy, facility earned strong results in BRCGS, FDA and ISCC PLUS assessments, demonstrating excellence in packaging quality, product safety, sustainability and continuous improvement.
body_markdown:
## **Recent achievements reinforce the site’s commitment to quality, product safety, sustainability and continuous improvement**


At TriMas Packaging, quality, product safety, operational excellence and sustainability are central to how we support customers around the world. Reflecting this commitment, our Lodi, Italy, manufacturing facility recently completed several recurring certification and regulatory assessments, achieving strong results across each evaluation.


The facility earned a **Grade AA rating in its BRCGS audit** , a globally recognized standard that helps ensure packaging products consistently meet stringent safety, quality and regulatory requirements. Lodi also achieved a **95/100 score in its FDA assessment** , demonstrating the effectiveness of the systems and controls in place to support product safety and consumer protection.


In addition, the site successfully completed its **ISCC PLUS assessment with no findings** , reinforcing its commitment to sustainability initiatives and strengthening its ability to help customers advance their circular and bio-circular material goals.


These achievements are especially important for food and beverage applications and reflect the dedication of employees across the Lodi facility. Together, the results reinforce Lodi’s reputation as a trusted manufacturing partner and demonstrate TriMas Packaging’s ongoing commitment to delivering high-quality, safe and sustainable packaging solutions.
